name: Default New Tab
tagline: A new-session screen: where the chat starts and what needs you over the composer, your five latest chats as quiet rows.
description: cmux's Default New Tab page, rebuilt as a look on the public customization API: a cmux.newtab/1 view that draws the whole New Tab page, picked with tabs.newTabApp. Remove it and cmux's own New Tab page comes back.
